ask: Loading an unsigned driver on a machine with driver signature enforcement on. One line: the options.
text: Test-signing mode with your cert installed in Trusted Root, `nointegritychecks`/KDNet debugging (both reboot-gated and leave a watermark), proper signing via WHQL or a cross-cert, or BYOVD — abusing a known vulnerable signed driver (e.g. cpuz141, iqvw64e) to get kernel execution and either map your unsigned driver by hand or patch the DSE check in memory, which needs no reboot and leaves no watermark.
